en.bdb: How the apostate could be set right

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਖੂਹਹੁ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਗਲਿ ਬਧੇ ਪਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: jiau kar khoohahu nikalai gal badhe paanee|

en.bdb: The water is drawn out of well only when the pitcher is tied from the neck (with rope).

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮਣਿ ਕਾਲੇ ਸਪ ਸਿਰਿ ਹਸਿ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: jiau man kaale sap sir has dhei na jaanee|

en.bdb: The cobra does not happily give away the jewel in the head (it gives only after getting killed).

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਣ ਕਥੂਰੀ ਮਿਰਗ ਤਨਿ ਮਰਿ ਮੁਕੈ ਆਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: jaan kathooree mirag tan mar mukai aanee|

en.bdb: The deer also gives musk only after its death.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੇਲ ਤਿਲਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਪੀੜੇ ਘਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: tel tilahu kiau nikalai vin peeRe ghaanee|

en.bdb: The deer also gives musk only after its death.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮੁਹੁ ਭੰਨੇ ਗਰੀ ਦੇ ਨਲੀਏਰੁ ਨਿਸਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: jiau muh bha(n)ne garee dhe nale'eer nisaanee|

en.bdb: The kernel of coconut can be got only when its mouth is broken.
The apostate is such an iron that can be given desired shape only with the strokes of hammer.
